subject: dbc_contracts
summary: Reservation.ocl defines checkable pre/post for reserve at standard density: PrincipalAuthorized, QuantityPositive, SufficientAvailableStock, HoldCreatedWithTtl, AvailableStockReduced. Not vacuous. Named error mapping for InsufficientStock/Unauthorized is documented as adapter convention. Release/expire remain commented hooks for W4/W5 — acceptable for this slice.
